# C10 design: review queue and claims

Covers the screens of REVIEW01 (queue and 48-hour claims), REVIEW02 and AUTH10 (conflicts, shown without detail), REVIEW13 (expiry order and time left), NFR24 (the queue on a phone) and NFR27 on every surface. The sweep, the alerts email and the reviewer HLS routes have no UI. Builds on D02 (shell, `ListPage`, `DetailPage`, states), C02 (scout profile, reviewer terms, `requireReviewerPage`), C06 (match list rows, `FixtureMarkers`, footage line, match page status text) and C07 (`ExpiryBanner` placement).

Surfaces:

1. Review queue: `/review` (replaces the D02 placeholder)
2. Claim confirmation (new): `/review/matches/[matchId]/claim`
3. Claimed match (new): `/review/claims/[claimId]` (C11 turns it into the workspace)
4. Club match page status text: `/matches/[matchId]` (copy only)
5. Scout affiliations, cooling-off copy: `/scout` (copy only)

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **Earlier rules still apply (D01, D02, C01 to C09).** Tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Text uses the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `display-xl`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule (2px `focus`, 2px offset).
- **Who.** Surfaces 1 to 3 are for approved scouts on the current reviewer terms: on a phone at the sideline or on a laptop. Both are first-class (NFR24); the phone layout is designed, not squeezed. Surface 4 is for coaches and club admins; surface 5 for scouts.
- **Guards.** Every `/review/**` page calls `requireReviewerPage()`; every action calls `requireReviewer()`. A pending, suspended or stale-terms scout goes to `/scout?from=review` (existing C02 behaviour and copy). Not signed in: the login redirect. Anyone without the scout role: `/forbidden`.
- **Theme.** No C10 surface is forced dark. The queue, claim and claimed pages follow the system setting. Only the C11 workspace will be dark; C10 sets no `ThemeScope`.
- **No footage, no players.** C10 renders no video, no still and no player name anywhere (REVIEW11, A-3, A-14). Queue rows hold match-level facts only. Nothing goes to `localStorage`.
- **Conflicts never name the affiliation (A-8).** The UI says that the scout is linked to a club or player in the match. It never says which club, player or reason code (`organisation`, `team_name`, `player`).
- **Times.**
  - Time left uses `formatTimeLeft(ms)` (`components/ui/expiry.ts`). It floors, so it never overstates: **3 days** (72 h to 95 h), **2 days**, **1 day** (24 h to 47 h), **23 hours**, **1 hour**, **under 1 hour**. Hours only appear under 24 h.
  - Footage deletion dates use `formatDeletionDate` (**Friday 24 Oct**).
  - Exact claim end times use `formatDateTime` (**31 Oct 2026, 14:05**), in `span.data`.
  - The club's due time uses `formatReadyBy` (**15:40**, **09:10 tomorrow**, **Mon 27 Oct, 09:10**).
  - Played dates use `formatDate` in tables and cards (**18 Oct 2026**) and `formatMatchDate` in heroes (**Sat 18 Oct 2026**).
  - All times are South African time (`Africa/Johannesburg`, as every formatter already does). The claim page says so once (Q-060).
  - **No live ticking.** Times are worked out on the server at render time (`now` passed down). Nothing counts down in the browser and nothing announces itself as time passes (Q-061). Every navigation and every action re-renders with a fresh `now`.
- **Match length** is `2 × {halfLengthMinutes} min` (**2 × 35 min**), in `data`.
- **Events to check** is the `pending_review` count: **12 events to check**, **1 event to check**; zero: **No events to check** (`text-ink-muted`). In table cells the number alone in `data` (numeric column), with the header **To check**.
- **Age group** is the home team's `ageGroup`, else the away team's; missing is left out (cards, sentences) or `Missing` (tables).
- **"Log in as" sessions (Q-064).** Applies only if the impersonation work is committed before C10. When `ctx.impersonator` is set, every review page renders as usual (the shell's `ImpersonationBanner` is already on top), but nothing can be claimed or released, because the declaration must be the scout's own. The pages show the note below in place of the claim form (Surface 2) and the release trigger (Surface 3), and both actions refuse on the server with the same copy, whatever the client sends. Queue **Claim** links stay (they lead to the claim page, which shows the note). The note: `Banner tone="warn"` **You are logged in as this scout. Only the scout can claim or release a match, because the declaration must be their own.** Export it as `IMPERSONATION_REFUSED` from `src/server/review/errors.ts`. If impersonation is not committed, leave this out.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, *match*, *club*, *squad*, *claim*, *release*. No contractions (the app uses none), no exclamation marks, no emoji. Copy marked *draft* below waits for legal review (Q-058) and is still final for the build.
- **Motion.** 150ms ease-out on hovers. Nothing spins. No count-down animation.
- **Loading.** Add `review/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`), `review/matches/[matchId]/claim/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`) and `review/claims/[claimId]/loading.tsx` (`DetailSkeleton`). Errors fall to `(app)/error.tsx` (`ErrorState`).

### Chip preset: `CLAIM_STATES` in `components/ui/StatusChip.tsx`

`ClaimStatusChip({ status })`, keyed by the Prisma `ReviewClaimStatus` enum (so a new status fails to compile), exported from `components/ui/index.ts`. Add one fixture per state to the `/dev/components` StatusChip group.

| Status | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | warn | `Timer` | Claimed |
| `submitted` | ok | `Check` | Reviewed |
| `released` | neutral | `Undo2` | Released |
| `expired` | neutral | `TimerOff` | Expired |

`active` is `warn` because the claim has a deadline and needs the scout's attention (the StatusChip README's "needs attention" tone, as `awaiting_review`).

### Time-left pieces (`components/ui/ExpiryBanner.tsx`)

Three small server-safe components (no `"use client"`, no `server-only`), built on `expiryLevel` and `formatTimeLeft`. Each is `span.wl-inline-status.caption` (the `--muted`, `--warn` or `--danger` modifier) with a Lucide icon through `iconProps` and words, or the existing `ExpiryLabel` chip. None of them is a live region and none ticks. Move the private `InlineStatus` helper from `matches/shared.tsx` next to them (or reuse its markup) so the class list is written once.

**`FootageTimeLeft({ expiresAt, now })`.** The footage line for review rows, lifted out of C06's `FootageLine` in `matches/shared.tsx`. `FootageLine` keeps its own guard (no expiry, or already past: `Missing`, as today) and calls `FootageTimeLeft` otherwise, so the club match list does not change.

| Raw footage left (`expiryLevel`) | Renders | Example |
|---|---|---|
| more than 72 h (`none`) | `--muted`, `Clock`, **Footage deleted in {formatTimeLeft}** | 73 h: **Footage deleted in 3 days** |
| 72 h down to 24 h (`warning`) | `ExpiryLabel`: `wl-chip--warn`, `Clock`, **{formatTimeLeft}**, sr-only prefix **Footage deleted in** | 48 h: **2 days** |
| under 24 h (`danger`) | `ExpiryLabel`: `wl-chip--danger` | 23 h: **23 hours** |
| past, not yet swept | `ExpiryLabel` **Due now** (danger) | |

The queue never passes a past expiry (`queueSection` moves that match to clips only), so **Due now** only shows if a page renders in the instant between.

**`ClaimTimeLeft({ expiresAt, now })`.** For the scout's own claims:

| Claim left | Renders | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 12 h or more | `--muted`, `Timer`, **Claim ends in {formatTimeLeft}** | 48 h: **Claim ends in 2 days**; 23 h: **Claim ends in 23 hours** |
| under 12 h | `--warn`, `Timer`, same words | 11 h: **Claim ends in 11 hours** |
| past (lazy expiry, A-5) | renders nothing: the row is not in `mine`, and the claimed page shows the ended state | |

`Timer` is for the claim and `Clock` for footage (design system: `clock` means footage expiry), and the words always say which one is meant.

**`ClipsTimeLeft({ clipsExpireAt, now })`.** For clips-only rows. Use `clipsExpireAt(rawExpiresAt)` from `src/lib/review-rules.ts` (raw expiry plus `CLIPS_ONLY_WINDOW_MS`):

| Clips left | Renders | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 24 h or more | `--muted`, `Scissors`, **Clips deleted in {formatTimeLeft}** | 73 h: **Clips deleted in 3 days**; 48 h: **Clips deleted in 2 days** |
| under 24 h | `--danger`, `Scissors`, same words | 23 h: **Clips deleted in 23 hours** |
| past | renders nothing (the match has left the queue) | |

### Fixture

Reuse `FixtureMarkers` from `app/(app)/matches/shared.tsx`: widen its prop type to `{ homeTeam: { name: string }; awayTeam: { name: string } }` so queue rows can pass it. Inline in tables (wrapping between the two markers), `stacked` in phone cards. `TeamMarker` already speaks **Home side: {team}** and **Away side: {team}**.

### Conflict note (`app/(app)/review/ConflictNote.tsx`)

Shown in place of the Claim button on a conflicted row:

- `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--muted.caption` with `ShieldOff`, then `span.body-strong` **You cannot claim this match**;
- under it, `span.caption.text-ink-muted.block` **You are linked to a club or player in it.**

`ShieldOff` (blocked) plus words; no colour carries the meaning. It is text, not a control: nothing to focus, no tooltip.

### Error copy: `REVIEW_ERROR_COPY` in `src/server/review/errors.ts` (final)

| Code | Copy |
|---|---|
| `declaration_required` | **Confirm that you have no link to either club or to any player in this match.** (field error on the declaration) |
| `already_claimed` | **Another scout claimed this match a moment ago. Choose another match from the queue.** |
| `conflict` | **You cannot claim this match because you are linked to a club or player in it. Your list is on your scout profile.** |
| `claim_limit` | **You already hold {limit} claimed {match or matches}. Finish or release it to claim another.** (limit 2 or more: **Finish or release one to claim another.**) |
| `not_available` | **This match is no longer waiting for review. It may have been reviewed or deleted.** |
| `not_found` | **We could not find that claim.** |
| `claim_ended` | **This claim has already ended.** |
| any other error | **We could not claim this match. Try again.** (release: **We could not release this match. Try again.**) |

### CSS

**No new classes.** Everything below is built from existing `wl-` classes: `wl-card`, `wl-table`, `wl-facts`, `wl-inline-status` (`--ok`, `--warn`, `--danger`, `--muted`), `wl-chip`, `wl-banner`, `wl-decision__choice` (`--top`, the C05 checkbox card), `wl-field__error`, `wl-link-row`, `wl-row`, `wl-dialog`. If the builder finds a gap, it adds a commented C10 block to `web/src/styles/components.css` in the C09 style and notes it in `knownGaps`.

### Gallery fixtures (`web/src/app/dev/components/Gallery.tsx`)

The gallery is the sixth surface: the builder and Wideline staff, on a desktop, with one job (see every state of the new pieces in both themes). Add, with the gallery's fixed `now`:

- **StatusChip group:** a row labelled **Claim** with `ClaimStatusChip` for each `ReviewClaimStatus` (map over the `CLAIM_STATES` keys, as the match row does).
- **ExpiryBanner group:** a row labelled **Time left** with `FootageTimeLeft` at 73 h, 48 h and 23 h; `ClaimTimeLeft` at 48 h and 11 h; `ClipsTimeLeft` at 73 h and 23 h. Each sits in its own `wl-row` cell so the chips do not run together.

Then regenerate the baselines with `make test-e2e-update ARGS=tests/e2e/gallery.spec.ts` and check that the diff shows only the new rows.

## Surface 1: review queue, `/review`

**Who, where, job.** An approved scout, on a phone at the sideline or on a laptop. One job: find the most urgent match they may review and claim it, or get back to the match they hold.

**Access and data.** `requireReviewerPage()`. `now = new Date()` once, passed to everything below. `reviewQueue(ctx, { now })` gives `mine` (`ClaimRow[]`), `waiting` and `clipsOnly` (`QueueRow[]`, already in `compareQueue` order), `claimLimit` (a number, `Infinity` when unlimited), `activeClaims`, `atLimit` and `capped`. "Limit reached" below means `atLimit`; "conflicted" means `row.conflicted`; the events-to-check count is `row.toCheck`. A match whose only claim ran out but has not been swept yet is listed under Waiting like any other (lazy expiry, A-5). Query param `done` (only `released` is known; anything else shows nothing, through `doneMessage`). Metadata title: **Review queue**.

### Structure (DOM order)

1. `ListPage` header: title **Review queue**; intro **Matches to claim, soonest footage deletion first.** (D02 copy), then a second line `span.caption.block.mt-1` **You can hold {claimLimit} claimed {match or matches} at a time. Each claim lasts 48 hours.** (one: **You can hold 1 claimed match at a time. Each claim lasts 48 hours.**; unlimited: **Each claim lasts 48 hours.** alone). No header action.
2. **Notice live region**, always rendered: `div[aria-live="polite"]` (`mt-6`, `empty:mt-0`). With `?done=released`: `Banner tone="ok"` **Match released. It is back in the queue for other scouts.**
3. **Expiry banner** (`mt-4`), at most one, `ExpiryBanner expiresAt now` (it renders nothing above 72 h). Which match it is about, in this order:
   1. the scout's own claimed match with the soonest raw footage expiry, if 72 h or less: children **{fixtureText} is yours to review. Finish it before {formatDeletionDate} to add missed events.**
   2. else the soonest **claimable** waiting match (not conflicted) with 72 h or less: children **{fixtureText} is waiting for a reviewer. Claim it before {formatDeletionDate} so missed events can still be added.** When the claim limit is reached, the second sentence is **Release or finish your claimed match to claim it.**

   Conflicted matches never drive the banner.
4. **Your matches** section (only when `mine` is not empty).
5. **Waiting for a reviewer** section (always, when the page is not empty).
6. **Clips only** section (only when `clipsOnly` is not empty).

Each section is `section aria-labelledby` (`mt-8`, the first `mt-6`), h2 `heading-2 mb-4` with the title, then `span.data.text-ink-muted.ml-2` {count} and `span.sr-only` **matches** (one: **match**), as the C06 match list. Then an intro `p.body.text-ink-muted.mb-4.max-w-prose` where given below, then `DataTable` with phone cards.

### Section: Your matches

No intro. `DataTable` caption **Your claimed matches**:

| Column | Header | Numeric | Cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| match | **Match** | no | `Link` to `/review/claims/{claimId}`, class `body-strong text-pitch underline`, with `FixtureMarkers` inline; under it `span.caption.text-ink-muted.block` **{organisation name} · {ageGroup} · {competition}** (missing parts left out) |
| played | **Played** | no | `formatDate(playedAt)` in `data whitespace-nowrap` |
| check | **To check** | yes | pending count |
| claim | **Claim** | no | `ClaimTimeLeft` |
| footage | **Footage** | no | `FootageTimeLeft` (clips-only claim: `ClipsTimeLeft`) |
| action | `span.sr-only` **Action** | no | `ButtonLink primary sm` **Open** (`ArrowRight`, icon after the word), `span.sr-only` suffix **{fixtureText}** |

**Open** is the page's one primary. With a claim limit of 2 or more, rows after the first use `secondary sm`.

### Section: Waiting for a reviewer

No intro, except the limit and all-conflicted notes below (the page intro says the order). `DataTable` caption **Matches waiting for a reviewer, soonest footage deletion first**. Order: `compareQueue` (raw expiry ascending, then played date, then id), so danger rows (under 24 h) are always at the top.

| Column | Header | Numeric | Cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| match | **Match** | no | `span.body-strong` with `FixtureMarkers` inline (not a link: scouts have no match page outside a claim); the club line as above |
| played | **Played** | no | `formatDate` |
| length | **Length** | no | **2 × 35 min** in `data whitespace-nowrap` |
| check | **To check** | yes | pending count |
| footage | **Footage** | no | `FootageTimeLeft` |
| action | `span.sr-only` **Action** | no | see "Row action" |

**Row action**, one of:

| Row | Content |
|---|---|
| claimable, under the limit | `ButtonLink secondary sm` **Claim**, `span.sr-only` suffix **{fixtureText}, played {formatDate}**; href `/review/matches/{matchId}/claim` |
| claimable, limit reached | `Button secondary sm disabled` **Claim** (same sr-only suffix), `aria-describedby="review-limit-note"` |
| conflicted | `ConflictNote` |

**Limit note.** When the limit is reached and at least one row is claimable, the section intro is `p#review-limit-note.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--muted.body` with `Lock` **Finish or release your claimed match to claim another.** (limit 2 or more: **Finish or release one of your claimed matches to claim another.**). It sits above the table, so it is read before the dimmed buttons, and the buttons point at it.

**Claim** is `secondary` on purpose: the queue is a list of equal choices, and the commitment (primary) is on the claim page.

### Section: Clips only

Intro `p.body.text-ink-muted`: **Raw footage for these matches has been deleted. You can still check events against their clips, but you cannot add missed events.** `DataTable` caption **Clips-only matches, soonest clip deletion first**. Columns as Waiting, with **Footage** replaced by **Clips** (`ClipsTimeLeft`). Same row actions, conflict note and limit rule (the limit note lives in the first section that needs it; later sections reuse its id). Order: raw expiry ascending (the same as clip expiry).

### Phone cards (under 768px)

One `li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-3` per row, the same in all three sections:

1. `FixtureMarkers stacked` in `span.body-strong` (in **Your matches**, inside the `Link`, class `wl-link-row text-pitch underline`, so the name block is a 44px target).
2. `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **{organisation name} · {ageGroup} · {competition}** (missing parts left out), then on its own line `span.data` **{formatDate}** then **· 2 × 35 min**.
3. `div.wl-row` (wraps): `ClaimTimeLeft` (your matches only), then `FootageTimeLeft` or `ClipsTimeLeft`, then `span.caption` **12 events to check**.
4. The row action, full width: `ButtonLink` or `Button` with `block` (48px, `justify-center`); or the `ConflictNote` (no button).

Cards carry no `id` attributes (DataTable rule); the limit note keeps its id in the section intro, outside the cards. `FixtureMarkers stacked` passes `truncate` today: in the queue, call it with a new `wrap` prop (or `truncate={false}`) so long names wrap instead of truncating. A scout must see the full team names to recognise a conflict.

### Layout

- **375.** Header (title `heading-1`, intro, limit line). Notice, banner (full width, text wraps). Sections stack as cards. With a claim, the first card under the header is **Your matches** with **Open**; without one, the most urgent waiting match. Bottom tab bar from the shell; the page keeps `wl-main--tabbar` padding.
- **768.** Tables replace cards, each in its focusable scroll region. The club line under the fixture wraps. The Action column keeps `whitespace-nowrap`. If the six columns overflow beside the rail, the region scrolls; the Match column is first, so the fixture is always visible.
- **1280.** Content column `max-w-7xl`. Tables at natural width; nothing scrolls sideways.

### States

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| **Empty** (no rows in any section) | `EmptyState` (with art) title **No matches waiting**, body **New matches appear here as clubs upload them.** No action. The header and the notice region stay, so `?done=released` still shows above it. |
| **Your claim only, nothing waiting** | **Your matches**, then **Waiting for a reviewer** with count 0 and `p.body.text-ink-muted` **No other matches waiting. New matches appear here as clubs upload them.** in place of the table |
| **Loading** | `ListSkeleton` (`review/loading.tsx`) |
| **Error** | `(app)/error.tsx` (`ErrorState`, **Something went wrong**) |
| **Forbidden / not approved / stale terms** | `/forbidden`, or `/scout?from=review` (C02 copy) |
| **Claim limit reached** | As "Row action" and "Limit note"; the header limit line stays |
| **Every row conflicted** | Rows show `ConflictNote`. The section intro is `p.body.text-ink-muted` **You cannot claim any of these matches because you are linked to a club or player in each of them.** then `Link` (`body text-pitch underline wl-link-row`) **Check your list on your scout profile** → `/scout#scout-conflicts-heading`. No banner from waiting rows. |
| **Danger row** (under 24 h) | First in its section (sort); danger `ExpiryLabel` chip with `Clock` and words. The banner above has `role="alert"`, so it is announced once on load. |
| **Long names** | Team and club names wrap in tables and cards; nothing truncates in the queue. |
| **Small sample** (one waiting match) | One row or card; the count reads **1 match**; nothing else changes |
| **"Log in as" session** | As usual; the claim page explains why it cannot claim (Q-064) |
| **No competition or age group** | Left out of the club line; never an empty separator |
| **200 rows (cap, A-2)** | No pagination. Only when the cap is hit, (`capped`) under the Waiting table, `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Showing the 200 matches with the soonest footage deletion.** (the number from `QUEUE_CAP`) |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- **Tab order:** skip link, shell nav, then the page: **Your matches** region and **Open**, then the **Waiting** region and each **Claim** in row order, then the **Clips only** region and its **Claim** buttons. Disabled **Claim** buttons are skipped (native `disabled`); the reason is the section intro just above, read in document order. Conflicted rows have nothing to focus.
- Each **Claim** and **Open** has a unique accessible name through its sr-only suffix (**Claim Hilton College U15 v Ajax Cape Town U15, played 18 Oct 2026**).
- Section h2s name their landmarks and speak the count (**3 matches**).
- Time-left pieces carry words; the chip's sr-only prefix reads **Footage deleted in 20 hours**. The only live regions are the notice div and the `ExpiryBanner`'s own role.
- No shortcuts on this page.

## Surface 2: claim confirmation, `/review/matches/[matchId]/claim`

**Who, where, job.** The same scout, one tap after **Claim**, often on a phone. One job: see what they are taking on (the match, 48 hours, the footage deadline, the terms), declare no conflict, and claim.

**Why a page, not a dialog.** It works without JavaScript, carries a declaration with legal weight (Q-058), and fits a phone without a modal over a long list. There is no dialog enhancement from the queue.

**Access and data.** `requireReviewerPage()`. `now = new Date()`. First `ownLiveClaimId(ctx, matchId, now)`: when the scout already holds a live claim on this match, `redirect("/review/claims/{claimId}")`. Then `queueMatch(ctx, matchId, now)` gives `{ row, claimLimit, atLimit }` (the queue's row shape, with `conflicted`), or null:

- null (unknown id, another scout's live claim, not awaiting review, suspended club, platform org, clips gone). An `in_review` match whose only claim has run out is claimable, so it is not null (lazy expiry, A-5). Null always gives the "not available" state below. Never `notFound()` here: the same state for every case, so the page does not reveal whether a match exists.

Metadata title: **Claim a match**.

### Structure (DOM order)

Column `max-w-2xl` (whole page, 1 column at every width).

1. `PageHeader`: back **Review queue** (`/review`); eyebrow **Claim a match**; title `fixtureText` (`heading-1`, `break-words`); intro **{organisation name} · {ageGroup} · {competition}** (missing parts left out).
2. **Match facts**, `div.wl-card.mt-6`, `dl.wl-facts` (`dt.label`, `dd.body`, values in `data` where numeric):

   | Term | Value |
   |---|---|
   | **Teams** | `FixtureMarkers` inline (wraps) |
   | **Played** | `formatMatchDate(playedAt)` |
   | **Length** | **2 × 35 min** |
   | **Events to check** | **12 events to check** (or **No events to check**) |
   | **Raw footage** | **Deleted {formatDeletionDate}, in {formatTimeLeft}** in `data`; clips-only: `span.wl-inline-status--muted` `Scissors` **Deleted. Clips kept until {formatDeletionDate(clipsExpireAt)}** |

3. **Footage notice** (`mt-4`), one of:
   - raw footage 72 h or less: `ExpiryBanner` with children **Claim it now to add missed events before then.**;
   - clips only: `Banner tone="warn"` **Raw footage for this match has been deleted. You can check events against their clips, but you cannot add missed events.**;
   - otherwise nothing.
4. **If you claim it**, `section` h2 `heading-2 mt-8`:
   - `p.body` **You have 48 hours to review it. If you claim it now, your claim ends on {formatDateTime(claimEndsAt(now))}.** (the time in `span.data`)
   - `p.body.mt-2` **Nobody else can review it while you hold it. If you do not finish in time, it goes back to the queue for other scouts. You can release it sooner.**
   - `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Times are South African time.**
5. **Your reviewer terms**, `section` h2 `heading-2 mt-8` (draft copy, for legal review with Q-004 and Q-058):
   - `ul.wl-checklist.mt-3` (each `li` with `ShieldCheck`, `p.body`):
     - **Footage streams in Wideline only. You cannot download it.**
     - **Footage carries a watermark that identifies you.**
     - **Do not record, screenshot or share anything you see.**
     - **Players are named only where their family agreed. Others show as side and shirt number.**
   - `Link` (`body text-pitch underline wl-link-row`) **Read the full terms** → `/scout#terms`.
6. **Claim form**, `form` (client `ClaimForm`, `useFormAction`, `noValidate`, `mt-8`), posting `claimMatchAction(matchId, formData)`:
   1. `FormErrorBanner` (danger, `role="alert"`) for form-level errors.
   2. The declaration, a C05 checkbox card: `label.wl-decision__choice.wl-decision__choice--top` containing `input type="checkbox" name="declaration" value="yes" required aria-required="true"` and `span.body` **I have no link to either club or to any player in this match.** (draft, Q-058). Under the card, `p#claim-declaration-hint.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **This includes clubs and players you stopped working with in the last 90 days. Wideline records that you confirmed this.** The input has `aria-describedby="claim-declaration-hint"` (plus the error id when shown).
   3. Field error under the hint: `FieldErrorText id="claim-declaration-error"` **Confirm that you have no link to either club or to any player in this match.**; the input gets `aria-invalid="true"`.
   4. `div.wl-row.mt-6`: `SubmitButton` primary **Claim match** (`Timer` icon), pending **Claiming…**; `ButtonLink secondary` **Cancel** → `/review`. Under 768px both `block` (48px, full width), Claim match first.

**Success.** The action redirects to `/review/claims/{claimId}?done=claimed` (Surface 3 notice).

### Errors

All copy from `REVIEW_ERROR_COPY`. Focus: after a failed submit, `useFocusFirstInvalid` moves focus to the declaration checkbox when it is invalid, else to the `FormErrorBanner` (`tabIndex={-1}`).

| Case | Where | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `declaration_required` | field error on the checkbox | The form stays; nothing else changes |
| `already_claimed` | `FormErrorBanner` | The form is replaced by the banner plus `ButtonLink primary` **Back to the review queue** (`/review`). The facts stay above for context. |
| `conflict` | `FormErrorBanner` | Form replaced: the banner plus `ButtonLink primary` **Back to the review queue** and `Link` **Check your list on your scout profile** → `/scout#scout-conflicts-heading` |
| `claim_limit` | `FormErrorBanner` | Form replaced: the banner plus `ButtonLink primary` **Go to your claimed match** → `/review` (the queue lists it on top) |
| `not_available` | `FormErrorBanner` | Form replaced: the banner plus `ButtonLink primary` **Back to the review queue** |
| other | `FormErrorBanner` | The form stays, so the scout can try again |

When the form is replaced, focus moves to the banner (it is `role="alert"` and announced).

### States (page)

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| **Loading** | `DetailSkeleton` |
| **Conflicted on load** (`queueMatch` says `conflicted`) | Header and facts as usual; sections 4 and 5 left out; in place of the form, `Banner tone="danger"` with the `conflict` copy, then the two links of the `conflict` row above. No checkbox, no Claim button. |
| **Limit reached on load** (`atLimit`) | As conflicted, with the `claim_limit` copy (`reviewErrorCopy(new ReviewError("claim_limit", claimLimit))`) and its link |
| **"Log in as" session** (Q-064) | Sections 1 to 5 as usual; in place of the form, the impersonation `Banner tone="warn"` and `ButtonLink secondary` **Back to the review queue**. The conflicted and limit states take precedence, because they apply to the scout too. |
| **Small sample** (no events to check) | **Events to check** reads **No events to check** (`text-ink-muted`). The claim is still allowed, so the scout can add missed events. |
| **Not available** (null) | `PageHeader` back **Review queue**, title **Claim a match**; then `EmptyState art={false}` title **This match is not available**, body **Another scout may have claimed it, or it has been reviewed or deleted.** action `ButtonLink primary` **Back to the review queue** |
| **Error / forbidden** | `(app)/error.tsx`; `/scout?from=review` or `/forbidden` |
| **Long content** | Long team and club names wrap in the title and the facts (`overflow-wrap: anywhere` is already on `wl-facts dd`) |
| **Partial data** | No competition or age group: left out of the intro. `ageGroup` not shown as a fact. |

### Layout

- **375.** One column at the 16px gutter: header, facts card (term over value), notice, the two text sections, the declaration card (the whole card is the 48px+ tap target), then Claim match and Cancel stacked full width.
- **768.** Same column, `max-w-2xl`; facts become two columns (`wl-facts` from 768); buttons side by side, left aligned.
- **1280.** Same; the column stays `max-w-2xl`, left aligned in the content area like other form pages.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- **Tab order:** back link, **Read the full terms**, the declaration checkbox, **Claim match**, **Cancel**. Space toggles the checkbox (native).
- The checkbox's name is its label; its description is the hint (and the error after a failed submit). The checkbox focus ring draws around the card (`.wl-decision__choice:has(input:focus-visible)`, C05).
- Errors are announced through `role="alert"` (banner) or the field error linked by `aria-describedby`.
- `Enter` in the form submits it; the checkbox must be ticked or the server answers `declaration_required` (no browser validation tooltip: `noValidate`).

---

## Surface 3: claimed match, `/review/claims/[claimId]`

**Who, where, job.** The scout who holds the claim, straight after claiming or from **Open** in the queue. One job in C10: see how long they have and release the match if they cannot do it. C11 replaces the middle of this page with the workspace and keeps the hero facts and **Release match**.

**Access and data.** `requireReviewerPage()`. `now = new Date()`. `ownClaim(ctx, claimId, now)`: the caller's claim in any status, with match-level fields. Null (unknown id, or another scout's claim) → `notFound()` (the app's 404 page). `ownClaim` already reports an `active` claim past `expiresAt` as `expired` (lazy expiry, A-5), so the page only branches on `status === "active"`. Query param `done` (`claimed`). Metadata title: **Claimed match**.

### Live claim (`DetailPage`)

- back **Review queue** (`/review`).
- eyebrow **Your claimed match**.
- title `fixtureText`.
- meta **{formatMatchDate} · {organisation name} · {ageGroup} · {competition}** (missing parts left out).
- badges: `ClaimStatusChip status="active"` (**Claimed**); `ExpiryLabel` when raw footage has 72 h or less.
- actions: none in the hero (the page has no primary in C10; Release lives in its own section, so C11 can put the workspace above it).
- notice, in order:
  1. always-rendered `div[aria-live="polite"]` (`mt-6`, `empty:mt-0`): with `?done=claimed`, `Banner tone="ok"` **Match claimed. It is yours until {formatDateTime(expiresAt)}.**
  2. `mt-4`: `ExpiryBanner` (raw footage 72 h or less) with children **Finish your review before {formatDeletionDate} to add missed events. Stats you confirm are kept.**; or, clips only, `Banner tone="warn"` **Raw footage for this match has been deleted. You can check events against their clips, but you cannot add missed events.**
- sections (`DetailPage` sections, h2 `heading-2`):

**Section: Your claim** (`id` `claim`). `div.wl-card` with `dl.wl-facts`:

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| **Time left** | `ClaimTimeLeft` (words and icon) |
| **Claim ends** | `formatDateTime(expiresAt)` in `data` |
| **Claimed** | `formatDateTime(claimedAt)` in `data` |
| **Events to check** | **12 events to check** |
| **Raw footage** | as Surface 2 (**Deleted {date}, in {time left}**, or the clips-only line) |

Under the card, `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Times are South African time. If the time runs out, the match goes back to the queue.**

**Section: Review** (`id` `review`). Draft copy, replaced by C11: `p.body` **The review workspace opens here. You will watch the footage, confirm or correct each event, and add missed ones.** No button, nothing focusable.

**Section: Release** (`id` `release`). `p.body.max-w-prose` **Release the match if you cannot finish it. It goes back to the queue for other scouts, and you can claim it again later if nobody else has.** Then `ConfirmDialog`:

| Part | Content |
|---|---|
| trigger | `secondary`, icon `Undo2`, label **Release match**, `block` on phones |
| title | **Release this match?** |
| body | **The match goes back to the queue for other scouts. Any corrections you made stay.** |
| hidden | `claimId` |
| submit | `primary` **Release match**, pending **Releasing…** |
| cancel | **Cancel** (focus starts here, ConfirmDialog rule) |

Leave `closeOnError` at its default (`false`): errors stay in the dialog, where focus already is. On success, `releaseClaimAction` redirects to `/review?done=released` (Surface 1 notice). On `claim_ended` (the claim ran out, or was released elsewhere, while the page was open) it redirects to `/review/claims/{claimId}`, so the page renders the ended state with its reason, which says more than an error would. Errors shown in the dialog's `FormErrorBanner`: `not_found` **We could not find that claim.**; any other error **We could not release this match. Try again.** (the scout can submit again).

**"Log in as" session (Q-064).** The Release section keeps its text; the trigger is replaced by the impersonation `Banner tone="warn"`.

### Ended claim

Same `DetailPage` hero (back, eyebrow **Your claimed match**, title, meta) with badges `ClaimStatusChip` for the ended status (**Reviewed**, **Released** or **Expired**). No footage banner, no sections. Instead, `notice`: `div.wl-card.mt-6` with h2 `heading-2` **This claim has ended**, `p.body.mt-2` the reason, `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-1` **Ended {formatDateTime(endedAt ?? expiresAt)}.**, and `ButtonLink primary.mt-4` **Back to the review queue** (`/review`).

| Status and reason | Reason copy |
|---|---|
| `expired` (or `active` past `expiresAt`) | **Your 48 hours ran out, so the match went back to the queue. You can claim it again if it is still waiting.** |
| `released`, reason `scout` | **You released this match. It went back to the queue for other scouts.** |
| `released`, reason `conflict` | **This claim was released because you added a club or player linked to this match.** |
| `released`, reason `admin` (C18) | **Wideline staff released this match.** |
| `released`, reasons `suspended`, `no_profile` | **This claim was released.** (the guard normally redirects these scouts first) |
| `submitted` (C11) | **You marked this match as reviewed. Thank you.** |

### States (page)

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| **Loading** | `DetailSkeleton` |
| **Not your claim / unknown** | `notFound()`: the app's 404 page |
| **Error / forbidden** | `(app)/error.tsx`; `/scout?from=review` or `/forbidden` |
| **Just claimed** (`?done=claimed`) | The ok banner in the notice region, announced politely. Any other `done` value shows nothing. |
| **Under 12 h left** | `ClaimTimeLeft` in its warn form, in the facts; no extra banner (the footage banner is for footage only) |
| **Clips only** | The warn banner above; the raw footage fact shows the clips line |
| **Long content** | Title and meta wrap (`break-words`) |

### Layout

- **375.** Hero (title `heading-1`), notices, then each section full width; facts term over value; **Release match** full width (48px). The dialog's actions stack (existing `wl-dialog` phone rule).
- **768.** Hero `display-xl`; facts two columns; trigger at natural width.
- **1280.** Content column `max-w-7xl`; the facts card and the release text keep `max-w-2xl` so lines stay readable.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- **Tab order:** back link, then **Release match**. In the dialog: **Cancel** (initial focus), **Release match**; Esc closes it and returns focus to the trigger (native `dialog`).
- Section h2s are landmarks. The `?done=claimed` banner is in a polite live region, so it is announced after the redirect. The footage banner keeps the `ExpiryBanner` roles (status, or alert under 24 h).
- Ended state: the h2 **This claim has ended** comes right after the hero; nothing moves focus.

## Surface 4: club match page status text, `/matches/[matchId]`

**Who, where, job.** Coaches and club admins (C06 Surface 6). One job: know that review is under way and when it is due. Copy only; no layout change.

In `matchStatusText()`, `in_review`:

| Case | Copy |
|---|---|
| an active claim is found (`ctx.db.reviewClaim.findFirst`, status `active`, `expiresAt > now`) | **A scout is reviewing this match. The review is due by {formatReadyBy(expiresAt, now)}.** (for example **due by 09:10 tomorrow**) |
| no live claim found (the claim ran out and the sweep has not run yet, or a race with release) | **Ready for review. A scout picks it up from the review queue.** (the `awaiting_review` copy, which is what the match is about to be) |

Pass the claim's `expiresAt` (or null) into `matchStatusText` as a new argument; do not query inside it. `awaiting_review` stays **Ready for review. A scout picks it up from the review queue.** The scout is never named (Q-059). The text is static (not a live region), as in C06. The time is South African time, as every club time.

## Surface 5: scout affiliations, `/scout` (copy only)

**Who, where, job.** A scout maintaining their conflicts list (C02 Surface). One job: understand that removing an entry does not unblock at once (Q-006).

Changes in `AffiliationsSection.tsx`:

| Place | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| section intro (`p.body`) | You cannot review a match involving a club on this list, or the club of a player you represent. Wideline staff match each name to a club on Wideline. A name blocks matches only once it is matched, so check the spelling. | **You cannot review a match involving a club on this list, a player you represent, or that player's club. We check these names against both teams and the lineups of every match, and Wideline staff match each name to a club on Wideline, so check the spelling.** |
| new line under the intro (`p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2`) | none | **A club or player you remove keeps blocking matches for 90 days.** |
| remove dialog body | You will be able to review matches involving {name} again. Wideline keeps a record that you removed it. | **{name} keeps blocking your review of their matches for 90 days, until {formatDate(now + 90 days)}. Wideline keeps a record that you removed it.** |
| removed banner (the message returned by the remove action in `scout/actions.ts`) | Removed {name}. | **Removed {name}. It keeps blocking matches until {formatDate(now + 90 days)}.** |

Work the date out from `now` and `CONFLICT_COOLING_OFF_DAYS` (`src/server/scouts/conflicts.ts`), never a literal 90, and format it with `formatDate` (**28 Jan 2027**). The intro's 90-day line reads the same constant. The dialog body uses the page's `now`; the banner uses the action's `now`.

The "Not matched yet" status line stays: matching still matters for linked organisations, but the intro no longer says an unmatched name blocks nothing (it now blocks by team name, REVIEW02, Q-052).

## Questions

- Q-050 to Q-059 and Q-064 come from the plan; the builder records them in `docs/build/QUESTIONS.md` (step 13). This spec takes their defaults: conflicted rows shown with no detail (Q-051), the clips-only section (Q-055), the draft declaration (Q-058), the scout not named to clubs (Q-059).
- Q-060: every review time is shown in South African time, with one "Times are South African time." note on the claim and claimed pages. Default taken as specified.
- Q-061: the queue and claim pages do not tick or refresh themselves; time left is as of the last page load. Default taken as specified.
- Q-064: in a "Log in as" session the review pages can be viewed, but claim and release are refused in the UI and on the server, with one warn banner. Default taken as specified; it applies only if impersonation is committed.
